svg.title: Aria Compute — technology stack and data flows
svg.desc: Six-stage architecture map of Aria Compute with 16 modules, three external services and six animated data flows. Touchpoints: agentbuddy is a Tauri v2 + Vue 3 desktop client for the workbench — 15 screens, 13 locales, no backend and no database; its in-process axum loopback reverse proxy on 127.0.0.1 forwards only /api, /a2a, /healthz and /.well-known, serves /__shell/* as the local control plane and reuses the agenthub session cookie, and chat channels (Slack, Teams, Telegram, SMS) deliver webhook tasks to the same hub. Orchestration: agenthub (A2A hub, port 3500) speaks JSON-RPC 2.0 message/send, message/stream, tasks/get, tasks/cancel and tasks/resume, keeps a five-kind asset registry with approval, parks and resumes HITL approvals, persists task state in PostgreSQL and dispatches to agent/cloud; mcpx (MCP gateway, port 8848) publishes any HTTP service as MCP tools. Agent runtime: agent/cloud (port 3000, SSE) hosts the agent/core recall-model-memorize loop, which reads and writes memo (on-device SQLite FTS5) and calls gateway over HTTPS; agent/cloud keeps context in PostgreSQL plus pgvector. Inference and routing: router (port 8899) sends System One decisions to engine (port 8011, /v1/systemone) or the ollaya-compatible daemon (port 11435) and forwards completions to external LLMs; gateway (Bifrost behind Caddy, 443) also proxies to LLMs. Models and training: model weights load into engine and ollaya, pin (port 8001) post-trains checkpoints, exports to engine and reports metrics to mlflow (port 5000). Knowledge plane: agentmem (Go, port 8080) is a knowledge hub for AI agents; agent/core calls /v1/knowledge and /v1/query, a rules-first smart router (R1-R7) sends only ambiguous choices to AFM-D System One with a fail-closed fallback to OKF, OKF + Git holds the only canonical knowledge bodies linked by content_hash + commit_sha, RAG adapters hold rebuildable projections, and Attested Computations turn sanctioned SQL into audited verdicts. A shared state substrate holds PostgreSQL plus pgvector, SQLite aria memo, Apache AGE, MLflow runs and OKF + Git bodies. Six flows cycle automatically every eight seconds: A2A task, decision via System One, memory and RAG, MCP tools and channels, knowledge plane, and train / export / serve.

g.title: agentbuddy — Tauri v2 + Vue 3 desktop client for the workbench, 15 screens and 13 locales, no backend and no database; an in-process axum loopback reverse proxy on 127.0.0.1 forwards only /api, /a2a, /healthz and /.well-known, serves /__shell/* as its local control plane and reuses the agenthub session cookie
channels — Slack, Teams, Telegram and SMS webhooks; inbound messages become A2A tasks and HITL approvals are answered from the same thread

agenthub — Go and PostgreSQL A2A hub, port 3500, JSON-RPC 2.0 message/send, message/stream, tasks/get, tasks/cancel and tasks/resume, five-kind asset registry with approval, HITL park and resume, channels, connectors and sandboxed execution
mcpx — MCP gateway, port 8848, publishes any HTTP service as MCP tools
HTTP services — any language or framework, reachable through the mcpx prefix allowlist
agent/cloud — Rust axum service, port 3000, OpenAI beta Agents API with SSE, Postgres and pgvector context
agent/core — recall, model, memorize agent loop with pluggable sandbox
memo — local-first long-term memory, SQLite FTS5 plus local embeddings, four relation views
router — OpenAI-compatible inference gateway, port 8899, semantic, agent and afm-d routers
gateway — Bifrost AI gateway behind Caddy or Nginx, port 443 to 8080
LLMs — external OpenAI-compatible upstream model vendors
engine — Rust AFM-D runtime, port 8011, POST /v1/systemone, C ABI
ollaya — local decision model daemon, port 11435, ONNX Runtime and llama.cpp
model — ModernBERT decision model trained with RLCD, 1024 token state, 512 token option head
pin — TRL post-training service, port 8001, LoRA lifecycle and gguf, mlx, mnn, qnn export
mlflow — experiment tracking on harness-net, port 5000
OKF + Git — canonical knowledge bodies; index.md, log.md and sanctioned .sql; linked by content_hash + commit_sha
agentmem — Go knowledge hub, port 8080, rules-first smart router with AFM-D System One fallback, dual-path read and Attested Computation
RAG adapters — pluggable, rebuildable projections over agentmem-bridge/v1 sidecars

g.text: Git is the only body authority
S1 fallback · fail closed to OKF
